canon.note: Luka (Physical, Nihility). Basic 111101 Direct Punch; with >=2 Fighting Will it becomes Sky-Shatter Fist (111107: 3 Direct Punches + Rising Uppercut, each punch 50% chance of an extra hit; Rising Uppercut detonates Bleed). Skill 111102 Lacerating Fist: 100% base chance to Bleed (DoT = 24% MaxHP, capped at #cap ATK, 3 turns), dispels 1 buff, +1 Fighting Will. Ultimate 111104 Coup de Grace: 100% base chance for target to take more DMG for 3 turns, +2 Fighting Will. Talent: at battle start 1 Fighting Will; A4 +3 Energy per stack gained. Energy 130.

fixtures.env: Luka E0 solo vs 3 Physical-weak Elite (level 95, 240 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7
Luka E1 solo vs the same Elites - acting against a Bleeding target grants luka_e1 +15% DMG (2 turns)

requirements.claim: Basic ATK Sky-Shatter Fist (111108, Physical) is the kit's Basic and fires in the fixture.
Skill Lacerating Fist (111102) fires as a Skill action (decide nihility.ts:823-827 prefers Skill while SP >= 1).
Coup de Grace (111104) fires once Energy reaches 130 (energyMax nihility.ts:821).
Lacerating Fist lands a single Physical hit (nihility.ts:864).
At >=2 Fighting Will the Basic upgrades to Sky-Shatter Fist (nihility.ts:885-900).
Sky-Shatter Fist ends with Rising Uppercut (nihility.ts:900).
Rising Uppercut detonates an existing Bleed as immediate DoT DMG (nihility.ts:902-906, 'Bleed Burst').
Coup de Grace lands a single Physical hit (nihility.ts:851).
Lacerating Fist inflicts Bleed as a Physical DoT (nihility.ts:866-873).
Coup de Grace applies an incoming-DMG vuln to the target for 3 turns (nihility.ts:847-849).
A4 grants +3 Energy per Fighting Will stack gained; the battle-start stack makes the first Luka ENERGY_GAIN n=3 (nihility.ts:804, 918).

Talent grants Luka 1 Fighting Will stack at battle start (nihility.ts:993-996 onStart → addFighting). Its A4 conversion produces the +3 Energy before any action, so the first Luka ENERGY_GAIN (n=3) precedes Luka's first action.
The Bleed is applied by the Skill before any later Bleed Burst detonation (nihility.ts:866 vs 902).
E1 Fighting Endlessly grants +15% DMG when acting against a Bleeding enemy (nihility.ts:836-837, dmgAll 0.15).
